title: Flagpost registry catalog index
description: The machine-readable catalog a registry serves so an instance can list and resolve modules/packs without downloading every artifact first. A signed, static, mirrorable document (draft: ADR-0040, docs/MODULES.md §5.1). Distributed with a DETACHED signature over its exact bytes (catalog-index.json + catalog-index.json.sig); the instance verifies that signature against the registry's pinned root key before trusting any entry.

generated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp the index was generated. Advisory only — freshness/trust comes from the signature, not this field.

entry.description: One catalog item (a module or pack) and its published versions.

trust_tier.description: declarative | code for modules; omitted for packs (a pack is the lowest trust level, 'pack').

capabilities.description: Summary of the capabilities the module's manifest requests, so a listing can show them before download. Authoritative source is the signed artifact's manifest.

paid.description: Whether obtaining this artifact requires a purchase/entitlement. Independent of the signature — a paid artifact is still verified the same way; the entitlement only gates download (docs/MODULES.md §7).

entitlement_required.description: Whether the instance must present an entitlement to download. Usually equals `paid`; kept separate so site-licensed free-to-that-org artifacts can be modelled.

yanked.description: A published version withdrawn by the publisher (e.g. a security issue). Already-installed instances keep it; new installs are refused.

url.description: Where to fetch the artifact. Content-addressed; a mirror MAY rewrite the host, so the digest — not the URL — is the identity.

signature.description: A detached signature over the artifact's exact bytes, verified by the instance against a key allowed by its trust policy.

key_id.description: Identifies the signing key (e.g. an ed25519 public-key fingerprint, or a sigstore identity). The instance maps this to a trust level via its policy.

value.description: Base64-encoded detached signature (for algorithm=ed25519), or a sigstore bundle reference.

verified.description: The registry vouches for this publisher's identity. Advisory in the index; the instance's trust policy decides whether 'verified' is sufficient to install.

digest.description: A content digest, algorithm-prefixed. Only sha256 is defined for v1.
